primary_endpoint: success within 180s, zero collisions, zero near misses
multiple_comparison_correction: Holm across two exact two-sided McNemar tests
confidence_interval: 5000 stratified paired bootstrap draws, seed 426; independent scenario-specific episode seeds
claim_rule: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0 for each claimed comparison
selection_rule: preserve six safe regression deliveries; then maximize 30 development safe deliveries, successes, minimize collisions and failure-penalized time; deterministic weight tie break

planning_assumptions.note: normal approximation for paired binary difference suggests about 470 episodes before multiplicity; 600 fixed episodes are a planning budget, not a power guarantee

demo_selection.rule: smallest final seed, irrespective of outcome
